Certification · v4.6

Complete POC update · 5 October 2026

Certificate configuration

Required configurationSource / behavior
Project/Program NameTemplate program title, associated with the project.
Trainee NameCertificate record; validated against the registered trainee.
Training NameCertificate record; matches the batch Training Plan.
Training DurationCertificate record; matches plan days.
Completion DateValid date on/after batch end and not in future (POC validation contract).
Certificate NumberSupplied by the administrator; globally unique in this POC.
Authorized SignatoryTemplate signatory name. No electronic signature is claimed.
Organization LogoOptional PNG/JPG/WebP upload; bundled Schoolnet logo is the default.
Project LogoOptional PNG/JPG/WebP upload. Sample templates use a clearly marked sample project logo.
Custom colour schemeTemplate hex colour used for border, heading and signatory line.

Two Excel uploads

Certificate templates: use master-certificateTemplates-template.xlsx. Fill Template Code, Project Code, Project/Program Name, Authorized Signatory, Colour Scheme, Landscape/Portrait layout and optional logo filenames. Select the workbook and matching actual logo files, then Validate upload and Save validated upload.

Certificate records: use master-certificateRecords-template.xlsx. Fill Certificate Number, Trainee ID, Batch Code, Template Code, Trainee Name, Training Name, Training Duration and Completion Date. Preview revalidates all rows. Invalid rows or a duplicate prevent the whole list from being saved; current data and permissions are checked again at save.

Manual configuration

Schoolnet Admin can add/edit templates and create certificate records. Selecting a trainee pre-fills batch, name, training, duration and completion date from the current training records. Edits to templates preserve saved certificate snapshots. Imports add templates/records; they do not overwrite existing ones. Use Edit template to change a template.

Samples and downloads

Three synthetic certificate samples are included: navy landscape, orange landscape and blue portrait. Open them under samples/certificates/ or choose View sample / Download sample from Certification. Each includes both organization and sample project logos, all certificate fields and a SAMPLE label. HTML samples are standalone with embedded logos and can be printed or saved as PDF using the browser. A4 print orientation follows the layout.

Certificate records support scoped preview and printable HTML download. Download all visible certificates produces a ZIP of standalone HTML certificates. A record includes a snapshot of the template title, signatory, logos, colour and layout; later template edits do not alter that record.

Eligibility and review boundaries

Actual certificate record creation/import requires trainer approval, elapsed required days and the existing configured completion criteria/evidence. Unresolved thresholds continue to block certification. Sample layout previews are available without changing eligibility or training data. One record per trainee/batch and globally unique certificate numbers are the provisional identity contract; numbering format, reissue/revoke policy and production issuance need business confirmation.

All records are marked LOCAL POC and do not constitute secure production issuance. No digital signature, PDF-generation service or external verification is implemented. Logo files are embedded as image data; metadata and template snapshots use local browser storage and quota failures report unsuccessful saves. Real authorization, storage, issuance and audit require a backend. Tests use non-browser fixtures; actual browser printing/layout remains unverified.
